name: au-with-misprint
description: Australian transaction account: "03 Dec" dates with no year over a 1 Dec 2025 to 28 Feb 2026 period (year rolls over), Date | Transaction details | Debit | Credit | Balance with balances printed as "1,234.56 CR". OPENING BALANCE and CLOSING BALANCE rows, descriptions that wrap onto a continuation line (no date or amount; some contain "Value Date: dd/mm/yyyy"), and "Balance carried forward" / "Balance brought forward" rows at page breaks. One printed balance (see mismatchDates) is deliberately 10.00 too high; balanceCents keeps the wrong printed value and every later balance is correct again.
